from typing import Union, TypeAlias
from attrs import define
from cattrs import Converter
from cattrs.strategies import configure_tagged_union

@define
class Node:
    value: int
    child: Union["Node", None]

# Recursive type alias
NodeAlias: TypeAlias = Union[Node, None]

def test_recursive_type_alias():
    converter = Converter()
    configure_tagged_union(NodeAlias, converter)
    
    node = Node(1, Node(2, None))
    unstructured = converter.unstructure(node, NodeAlias)
    print(f"Unstructured: {unstructured}")
    
    structured = converter.structure(unstructured, NodeAlias)
    print(f"Structured: {structured}")
    assert structured == node

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_recursive_type_alias()
EOF

    node = Node(1, Node(2, None))
    unstructured = converter.unstructure(node, NodeAlias)
    print(f"Unstructured: {unstructured}")
    
    structured = converter.structure(unstructured, NodeAlias)
    print(f"Structured: {structured}")
    assert structured == node

if __name__ == "__main__":
